Dehydrated Thyme Leaves Supplier — Dehydrated Thyme Leaves for Food Manufacturers and Export Buyers

Tradenest Naturals is a reliable dehydrated thyme leaves supplier for food manufacturers, distributors, restaurants, exporters, and private label brands. We supply clean, aromatic thyme leaves for bulk and wholesale requirements. Our product supports seasoning, bakery, ready-to-cook, sauce, soup, and snack applications. In addition, we offer export-ready packaging, flexible order quantities, and customer-specific specifications. As an experienced dehydrated thyme leaves exporter, we focus on consistent quality, practical service, and dependable supply. Buyers can request a sample, product specification, packaging proposal, and dehydrated thyme leaves price quotation from our sales team. We review each inquiry according to volume, destination, packaging, and quality requirements.

Product Overview

Dehydrated thyme leaves come from carefully selected thyme herbs. We clean and dry the leaves to reduce moisture while retaining their characteristic herbal aroma and flavor. The finished product provides a convenient alternative to fresh thyme. It offers easier storage, longer usability, and stable performance in commercial recipes. The leaves have a green to greyish-green appearance. They deliver a warm, earthy, slightly minty, and mildly peppery flavor. Therefore, they work well in recipes that need herbal depth without adding liquid. The product contains no intentionally added color, flavor, or preservative unless a buyer requests a customized formulation.

Manufacturing and Processing

Our process begins with raw material selection and incoming inspection. We check the herbs for visible quality, cleanliness, aroma, and general condition. Next, we remove unwanted plant matter and foreign materials through cleaning and sorting. We then use controlled dehydration to lower moisture and protect the product's sensory character. After drying, we inspect the leaves and process them through suitable sieving equipment. This step helps achieve the requested cut or mesh profile. Finally, we pack the product in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging.
  • Raw material selection and supplier evaluation
  • Cleaning, sorting, and foreign material removal
  • Controlled dehydration for moisture reduction
  • Sieving and size grading according to buyer needs
  • Batch inspection, packing, and traceability documentation
We can also discuss custom cutting, private label packing, and bulk supply programs. However, final specifications depend on the agreed product grade and intended application.

Typical Technical Specifications

Our standard dehydrated thyme leaves specification suits many food manufacturing applications. Buyers may request a different grade after sample approval. The following values represent typical commercial targets and should be confirmed before purchase.
  • Mesh or cut size: 8 to 16 mesh typical leaf cut; other sizes available on request
  • Moisture: typically 8% maximum
  • Purity: typically 99% minimum, subject to agreed specification
  • Appearance: clean green to greyish-green dried leaves
  • Flavor: characteristic thyme aroma with earthy, minty, and mildly peppery notes
  • Additives: no intentionally added additives in the standard product
  • Packaging: food-grade, moisture-resistant, and export-suitable formats
We can provide a product specification sheet with the quotation. Where required, buyers may also request batch-related quality documents and destination-specific paperwork. We do not claim certifications unless they apply to the confirmed production and supply arrangement.

Applications

Dehydrated thyme leaves add herbal flavor to many food products. They also help manufacturers standardize recipes throughout the year. Because the product has reduced moisture, it integrates easily into dry blends and prepared foods.
  • Seasoning blends for meat, poultry, seafood, and vegetables
  • Soups, sauces, gravies, marinades, and bouillons
  • Pizza, pasta, bakery, and savory snack formulations
  • Ready-to-cook meals and ready-to-eat food products
  • Herbal teas, stuffing mixes, and culinary herb blends
  • Restaurant, hotel, catering, and cloud kitchen recipes
For example, seasoning manufacturers can combine thyme with oregano, basil, rosemary, garlic, onion, and black pepper. Meanwhile, foodservice buyers can use the leaves in roasted vegetables, meat rubs, sauces, and baked products. We can discuss the desired cut size and flavor intensity for each application.

Buyer Benefits

  • Longer storage life than fresh herbs when stored correctly
  • Lower handling and preparation costs for commercial kitchens
  • Consistent flavor support across multiple production batches
  • Efficient use in dry seasoning and ready-to-cook formulations
  • Flexible pack sizes for distributors, manufacturers, and foodservice buyers
  • Export support with traceable batch and packaging information
Bulk dehydrated thyme leaves can help reduce frequent purchasing and preparation work. In addition, the dry format lowers dependency on fresh herb availability. This can support better inventory planning for manufacturers and hospitality businesses.

Packaging, Shelf Life, and Storage

We pack the product in moisture-resistant, food-grade materials. Standard options include pouches, jars, containers, and bulk export packs. Custom printed and private label packaging can also be evaluated for suitable order volumes.
  • Inner food-grade liner with outer woven or kraft bag
  • Stand-up pouches for retail and small wholesale orders
  • PET jars or HDPE containers for branded distribution
  • 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg bulk packs for industrial buyers
  • Custom private label and export packaging based on destination needs
The typical shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains sealed and stored under recommended conditions. Store it in a cool, dry, clean place. Protect the package from direct sunlight, high humidity, heat, pests, and strong odors. After opening, reseal the pack tightly and use a clean, dry utensil.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Export Supply

The minimum order quantity for a dehydrated thyme leaves supplier depends on product availability, packaging format, destination, and customization. Our typical starting MOQ for standard bulk supply is 25 kg. Smaller trial quantities may be possible for samples or selected stock. Private label, customized cuts, and printed packaging may require a higher MOQ. Lead time normally depends on stock status and order details. Standard orders may require approximately 7 to 15 working days after specification and payment confirmation. Custom packaging or larger export programs may require additional time. Therefore, we confirm the production schedule before accepting the order. For an accurate quote, share your required quantity, destination country, preferred mesh or cut, packaging size, label requirements, and target application. We can then review the inquiry and provide the dehydrated thyme leaves price, availability, estimated lead time, and shipping information. Sample requests should include the delivery address and intended use.

Quality Standards and Documentation

We follow documented food handling, cleaning, moisture control, inspection, and batch traceability practices. Our team reviews raw materials and finished goods against the agreed product specification. In addition, packaging carries essential information such as product name, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, and storage instructions. Certification requirements vary by destination and buyer policy. We therefore confirm available certificates and quality documents for the specific product, facility, and shipment before making any commitment. Buyers can communicate requirements such as allergen information, microbial testing, pesticide documentation, labeling rules, or import compliance during the quotation stage.

Why Work with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals operates as a manufacturer, wholesale supplier, and export partner within the food ingredients sector. Our capabilities include dehydration, grinding, blending, sieving, product standardization, and private label packing. As a result, we can support both straightforward bulk orders and broader ingredient programs. We aim to build long-term partnerships through clear communication and consistent specifications. Moreover, our team can help buyers compare packaging formats, optimize order volumes, and plan repeat supply. Contact Tradenest Naturals today to request a sample or quote for dried thyme leaves.
